messages.subject_clean: Will other version of "affy" affect the results?
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I am trying to install CellNet using R 3.2.2 on  Mac OS X 10.10.5. I had the same error as Yishai mentioned (namespace ‘affy’ 1.46.1 is being loaded, but <= 1.36.1 is required). I downloaded and installed affy 1.32.1, but there is a new error saying "package 'affy' was built before R 3.0.0. Please re-installed it".

Has anybody found the solution to this? I appreciate any help.

Thanks.
Parisa
